blocks.text: Updated Wed Feb 11 after the Ducal Freight discovery call. Changes from draft 1: Ducal requirements added, sync moved from nightly batch to events, field versioning section added.
Let Balcony App inspections flow into Montague's Mesh Routing in a shared format, with Ducal Freight as the pilot customer.
From this morning's call with Paris Duke (VP operations). His three asks, plus one line on data:
Offline sync. Inspectors work in the yards with little or no signal. An inspection made offline goes out on its own when the tablet reconnects. No manual resend, no "did it send?" button.
Signed PDF. One signed PDF per inspection, with the inspector's signature and the time signed. Their auditors need it within 24 hours.
Export by site. Inspections land in Ducal's freight system grouped by site, across their 30 yards and cross-docks.
Data. Ducal sees only its own data, the inspections from its own sites. No access to Montague's routing data.
